purpose: K-blind diagnostic of how many original 760 pairwise same-species matched trait comparisons can ALSO be supported by at least one common AusTraits dataset_id for both organ measurements on each species.

identity_rules.original_species: Exact originally eligible finite positive species median per source-native unit, with unambiguous species genus. Does NOT add any species unavailable in the original K graph.
identity_rules.family_trait_pair: Exactly the frozen 760 pairs with >=20 originally shared species and identical genus, unrelated to either K sign or module win rate.
identity_rules.shared_dataset_species: Of those originally shared trait-pair species, requires at least one IDENTICAL AusTraits dataset_id with at least one finite positive source-native numeric measurement of EACH trait for that same species; this does not require same observation_id.
identity_rules.stronger_same_observation_key_species: Separately count if any identical (dataset_id,observation_id) occurs for both trait source measurements of same species; an observation key MAY be study-specific and does not automatically mean same individual or physical specimen.
identity_rules.nested_source_lineage: A shared AusTraits dataset_id can contain compiled studies and distinct original measurements (e.g. Kew_2019_1), so it does not certify same PRIMARY measured specimen or across-dataset independence.
identity_rules.evidence_grain: Family×trait-pair counts only; never species names, original dataset/source IDs or numeric values in public artifact.

outputs: Reproduce all 760 K-blind original pair identities and source-native species counts from original AusTraits parquet.

Across the 760 original pair-support systems, report number retaining >=20 shared-dataset positive species, number retaining >=20 exact same observation keys, and counts split by within/between organ class.
For 36 reproductive×vegetative named pair types, report family support count and source shared-species count; separate seed-vs-vegetative and fruit-vs-vegetative.
Report original matched-tip K cohort availability only. Never calculate K effects, select favorable pair types, or claim same-DatasetID means source independence.
If source dataset/taxon graph fails prespecified support, conclude SAME_SOURCE_BIOLOGICAL_K_COMPARISON_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_AVAILABLE_OBSERVATIONS instead of tweaking exclusions.
hard_nonclaims: Within-AusTraits original measurement source support only, not independent TRY v7 data.
Observation IDs and dataset IDs are database-specific: matching IDs do not establish physical specimen identity across all source collections.
No evolutionary process alpha, selection, rate or organ-specific developmental constraint can follow from source-support counts.
The 760 pair K and subsequent organ grouping are post-outcome discoveries; this source support sensitivity is likewise post-outcome.
Closed BIEN 201-system rho study is not reopened and original OU/source-null classifier remains unchanged.
